deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (Imperial undergraduate courses)
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time, equal-consideration deadline; Imperial's institution code is I50. Applicants must also sit the course's admissions test (TMUA or ESAT).

english_policy.waiver_notes: All home, EU and overseas applicants must show they meet the English language level of their course (Standard or Higher); exemptions are listed on Imperial's English language exemption page.

english.notes: IELTS Academic, Standard level (Computing, Mechanical Engineering). Higher level (e.g. Economics, Finance and Data Science) is 7.0 overall with 6.5 in all elements. Single-sitting only; no single-score retakes.
Old 0-120 scale (tests before 21 Jan 2026), Standard level: 92 overall, minimum 20 in all elements. Higher level: 100 overall, minimum 22.
New 1-6 scale (tests from 21 Jan 2026), Standard level: 4.5 overall, minimum 4.5 in all elements. Higher level: 5.0 overall, minimum 5.0.
PTE Academic (test centre / UKVI SELT), Standard level: 62 overall, minimum 56 in all elements. Higher level: 69 with 62.
Standard level: 115 overall, no less than 105 in any integrated subscore. Higher level: 125 overall with 115.

tier_notes.general: Complete University Guide 2027 overall ranking: 5th of 130 UK universities (S = ranks 1-5 on the national scale).
